settingsMenu.mySettings: Name, language, theme and password of your account
settingsMenu.mySettingsMore: Your own name, the language of the interface, the theme (light, dark or automatic) and your password. The name stands on the tickets you work on.
settingsMenu.notifications: The channels the system reaches you on
settingsMenu.notificationsMore: The channels the system reaches you on: e-mail, Matrix, ntfy, Telegram, Signal, WhatsApp and the web push of the browser. A channel counts only after you confirmed it with a code.
settingsMenu.myShiftsMore: Your own shifts in the duty plan. Here you see when you are on call, whether you confirmed the shift and which shifts were offered to you.
settingsMenu.branding: Company name, logo and colours of the interface
settingsMenu.brandingMore: Company name, logo, title and the colours of the interface. The accent colour paints the active menu entry, the links of the settings and the focus ring of the operation.
settingsMenu.dashboardSettingsMore: The tiles of the start page and the wall display for the screen in the office. The display moves on by itself and needs no screensaver.
settingsMenu.objects: Master data of the objects and systems
settingsMenu.objectsMore: The master data of the objects and systems: name, number, system, priority and QR code. With the QR code somebody reports a fault for exactly this object.
settingsMenu.stickers: Print sheets for reports on site
settingsMenu.stickersMore: The print sheet for the stickers that hang at the object. Every sticker carries the QR code of the object and the notice of the emergency call 112.
settingsMenu.stickerTemplate: Geometry and appearance of the sticker sheets
settingsMenu.stickerTemplateMore: Geometry and appearance of the sticker sheets: the format of the sheet, the size of the sticker, the font and the fineness of the QR code.
settingsMenu.usersMore: The users of the installation with their roles and groups. A user needs at least one role, otherwise he does not see the interface.
settingsMenu.rolesMore: The roles and their permissions. A role bundles rights like “read ticket” or “maintain user”; the installation brings the roles admin and customer.
settingsMenu.groupsMore: The groups of the users. A group is the target of an assignment and the circle of recipients of an escalation.
settingsMenu.statusesMore: The states a ticket takes in its course, with their colour and their order. A state is always named as text too, never by its colour alone.
settingsMenu.standardTextsMore: The fault types a reporter chooses in the form, with the text that stands in the report. The text also stands in the report of the ticket.
settingsMenu.detectedErrorsMore: The errors that were detected on reports, for example a missing system type. They are assigned to a ticket and count in the statistics.
settingsMenu.escalationMore: The stages of the escalation and their actions: what happens when a ticket lies around too long. Every stage has a waiting time and triggers actions, for example a message to the on-call.
settingsMenu.defaultsMore: The values a new report starts with: priority, deadline, type of the object and the text of the report. They apply to every report, unless a report deviates from them.
settingsMenu.oncallMore: The on-call pools of the office, their duty blocks and the shifts in the plan. A pool is also the target of an assignment.
settingsMenu.channelsMore: The notification channels of the installation with their credentials. A channel is set up and tested here; only a confirmed code makes it work.
settingsMenu.delivery: Deliveries that did not go through
settingsMenu.deliveryMore: The deliveries that did not go through. The list names the channel, the error and the time. A delivery is quit as soon as the error is fixed.
settingsMenu.emailMore: The e-mail dispatch of the installation: the sender, the texts of the messages and the mailbox in which the reports of the office arrive.
settingsMenu.webhooksMore: Reports events to other systems, for example a ticket to a ticket system. Every webhook carries an address, a secret and the events it reports.
settingsMenu.apiKeysMore: The keys for the API of the installation. A key can read or write and is shown in clear text only once.
settingsMenu.bmaSyncMore: The synchronization of the objects with BMAcloud: new assets are taken over, changes are reported and conflicts are logged.

page.tickets: The tickets of the installation. The list opens with the open ones; the filters sit in the menu beside „Neue Meldung“.
page.ticketsCreate: A ticket the office creates itself — for example out of a phone call.
page.ticketSend: The message to the reporter: it names the state of the ticket and the way to the status page.
page.stats: The numbers of the installation: tickets, reaction time and processing time, by system, fault type and detected error.
page.oncall: Your stand-by and the duty plan: your shifts, their confirmation and the offers to swap them.
page.notifications: The tasks the system keeps ready for you — every message with a link to what is to be done.
page.settings: Every setting and administration page in one place, grouped by topic; the search finds every page.
page.settingsMe: Your account: name, language, theme and password.
page.objects: The objects and systems of the installation with their master data and their QR code.
page.objectCreate: Create a new object: number, name, system and priority.
page.objectImport: Import objects from a list — every row an asset with number and name.
page.objectEdit: The master data of the object and the QR code reports are made with.
page.stickers: The print sheets of the stickers for the objects — every sticker carries the QR code and the notice of the emergency call 112.
page.adminUsers: The users of the installation with their roles and groups.
page.adminRoles: The roles and their permissions — a role bundles rights like “read ticket”.
page.adminGroups: The groups of the users — target of an assignment and circle of recipients of an escalation.
page.adminApiKeys: The keys for the API; a key reads or writes and is shown in clear text only once.
page.adminEmail: The e-mail dispatch of the installation: sender, texts of the messages and the mailbox of the office.
page.adminChannels: The notification channels with their credentials; only a confirmed code makes a channel work.
page.adminDelivery: The deliveries that did not go through, with channel, error and time.
page.adminStatuses: The states a ticket can take, with their colour and their order.
page.adminWebhooks: Reports events to other systems — address, secret and the events per webhook.
page.adminBmaSync: The synchronization with BMAcloud: new assets are taken over, conflicts are logged.
page.adminDeadlines: The deadlines of the priorities — how long a ticket may lie around before it escalates.
page.adminEscalation: The stages of the escalation and their actions; every stage waits a time and then triggers actions.
page.adminDefaults: The values a new ticket starts with: priority, deadline, type of the object and text.
page.adminDetectedErrors: The errors that were detected on reports; they count in the statistics.
page.adminOncall: The on-call pools, their duty blocks and the shifts in the plan.
page.adminTextTemplates: The fault types and the texts of the reports.
page.adminBranding: Company name, logo, title and the colours of the interface.
page.adminStickerTemplate: Geometry and appearance of the sticker sheets: format, size, font and the fineness of the QR code.
page.adminDashboard: The tiles of the start page and the wall display for the screen in the office.
page.adminUpdate: The update of the installation — visible only with the matching right.
